scientific_question: Does absolute-radius boundary tracking persist when the Q=1 exact-null source is replaced by the Mooney-Rivlin coefficient-partition source at the same finite equilibrium state, observer, and interface nuisance projection?

classification.OBSERVER_GENERAL_SOURCE_IDENTITY_CONTROL: all 3 MR-partition cases localize and each winner reduces the orthogonal norm by at least 50%
classification.SOURCE_SELECTIVE_Q1_MECHANISM: at least 2 of 3 MR-partition cases either fail localization or have no >=50% eligible winner

claim_boundary: This control tests source identity only within the same 34x20 finite-BVP baseline and observer/interface model; it does not establish universality over arbitrary hyperelastic perturbations.
